integrity: Only new tangent-pair incidence and its sharp pencil obstruction are claimed; existing minimum-bidegree and individual-curve results are explicitly acknowledged.
scientific_limitations: Exact fixed-field fixed-bidegree coefficient-space enumeration, not a general finite-field theorem; the pair spectrum relies on reproducible Gröbner and tangent computations and awaits independent scientific validation.
title: Tangent rigidity of minimally filling genus-six curves on the binary split quadric
